data.long_meaning: In the Bible, Fleece refers to a piece of woolen cloth that was used by Gideon to test God's will. The fleece was filled with dew while the ground remained dry, signifying God's approval.

biblical_reference.note: Jacob uses fleece to deceive Laban and acquire the speckled and spotted sheep for his wives Rachel and Leah.
